description: High-fidelity spatial model of Victorian Rainfall Deficit. This dataset provides a continuous climate field across 2,957 Victorian suburbs.
methodology: Distance-Weighted Interpolation (Inverse Distance Weighting). Deficit values were calculated by mapping distance from six primary climate hubs (Mildura, Shepparton, Melbourne, Bairnsdale, Hamilton, Omeo) to suburb centroids extracted from official GeoJSON boundaries. A Gaussian decay function was applied to ensure realistic regional transitions, avoiding the 'collage' effect of traditional categorical mapping.
source: Bureau of Meteorology (Hub Data) + Spatial Modeling
citation: Bureau of Meteorology. (2026). Climate Data Online: Rainfall Deciles. Australian Government.
